title: Korgluk
html: Korgluk is a giant Shadow Orok Chieftain who is Boss rated. He is armed with the usual two axes and has a terrific knockback! Along with another Boss, Tugtor the Brash he guards the Teleporter at the end of Horrific Dungeon of Legend Stage 3 - Lower Cindercore. They are hard to defeat but drop lots of loot including possible Rainbows.
